_doc: ICW-06 (roadmap 21.6 PoC 1): the character assets, each a self-contained GLB packed by characters.pack_glb from one member of a free CC0 itch.io pack (packs below: page, file, sha256). The GLBs are registered external in assets/library.json (vault assets/3d/<kind>/<id>/); characters.fetch rebuilds one from its pack when the vault is out of reach. Nothing here is committed as a binary.
